item.title: 3 Super Bowl Architects Could Help Push Detroit Lions Super Bowl Push
item.description: Mike Payton reveals the Detroit Lions offense now carries coaching DNA from Sean Payton, Andy Reid, and Norv Turner, giving Dan Campbell one of the most elite offensive brain trusts in the NFL.

item.title: Detroit Lions Have Built-In Advantage on 2026 Schedule
item.description: The Detroit Lions could benefit in 2026 as several opponents break in new head coaches, giving Dan Campbell’s veteran roster a major continuity edge.

item.title: Pro Football Focus Predicts Detroit Lions Breakout Star for 2026
item.description: Pro Football Focus believes Lions guard Tate Ratledge is poised for a breakout 2026 season after a strong rookie year and elite run-blocking grades.

item.title: Jets Coaching Move Opens Door for Possible Lions Reunion
item.description: Former Lions passing game coordinator Tanner Engstrand is back on the market after a short stint as Jets OC. Should Detroit bring him back to boost the offense?

item.title: Tarik Skubal Trade Rumors Hit a Wall — And It’s a Big One
item.description: MLB insider Jim Bowden reveals why a Tarik Skubal trade is unlikely right now, citing the Detroit Tigers’ massive asking price that teams are unwilling to meet.

item.title: Detroit Pistons Land Jaren Jackson Jr. in Blockbuster Trade Proposal
item.description: A blockbuster mock trade would send Jaren Jackson Jr. to the Detroit Pistons in exchange for draft picks and young talent. Would this move create a true NBA title contender in Detroit?

item.title: 2026 Michigan Football Schedule Revealed
item.description: Michigan football has officially announced its full 2026 schedule, including matchups with Oklahoma, Penn State, Oregon, and Ohio State. Here’s the complete breakdown and what it means for the Wolverines.

item.title: Predicting Jahmyr Gibbs’ Contract Extension With Detroit Lions
item.description: The Detroit Lions are expected to exercise Jahmyr Gibbs’ fifth-year option and pursue a long-term extension.
